manual_review_reason: KALX currently accepts only physical, professionally pressed CDs or LPs and explicitly rejects downloads, file transfers, streaming links, videos, burned CD-Rs and other digital forms. A human must confirm that eligible pressed media exists, select the release, verify the current Music Director address, prepare the package, and approve production and postage costs before shipment.

CJSW accepts only digital EPs or albums released within the last three months, containing at least three unique tracks, supplied as MP3 files in one ZIP; singles are excluded. The external Jotform requires release metadata, website or streaming URL, bio, RIYL, ZIP upload, artwork, sharing and permanent-library permission, and contains a honeypot-style empty field. A human must verify eligibility and rights, prepare files, review the consent, avoid the protected field, and submit manually without automating the form.
